reconciliation.subject: Historical requirement identifier namespaces
reconciliation.observation: Historical requirement candidates are extracted from two historical sources into one HREQ namespace. Original source identifiers and locators are preserved on every record, so the July and August namespaces remain distinguishable by source rather than by identifier.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Legacy identifiers stay as source-bound aliases. HREQ identifiers are never reused for current requirements.

reconciliation.subject: Seventeen-route historical evidence versus the current route inventory
reconciliation.observation: The WP-006 route manifest records seventeen routes at commit 70c1f89. The current registry and route files record a larger set. The old count is version-bound evidence, not current truth.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Cite the current registry for present state; cite the manifest only with its commit.

reconciliation.subject: Product definition source of truth
reconciliation.observation: No single document is declared controlling for the product definition; three documents each carry part of it.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Owner names one controlling location before Wave 1 writes a Product Brief.

reconciliation.subject: Design posture versus runtime enforcement
reconciliation.observation: Default deny is declared as a design posture while no runtime authentication, role check, or row-level security exists in the tracked tree.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Record both truths on separate axes. Never report the posture as enforcement.

reconciliation.subject: Incomplete external advisory source
reconciliation.observation: The vulnerability scan is recorded NOT COMPLETED because the external advisory source is unavailable. A recovery source is recorded separately and does not replace it.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Preserve NOT COMPLETED. Do not convert an unavailable source into a pass.

consequences: Wave 1 may be authorized in a later message and extends the named canonical sources rather than creating new ones.

options.label: REVISE BASELINE
options.meaning: The baseline is materially wrong or incomplete in named places and must be re-derived before it is usable.
consequences: Only the named entries are re-derived; unrelated records are untouched.
The snapshot version increments and the previous version stays readable.
options.smallest_next_action: Name the artifact or reconciliation identifiers that are wrong, and what the correct reading is.

options.label: HOLD
options.meaning: No judgement is recorded now and the baseline stays available unchanged.
consequences: The snapshot remains candidate and non-controlling.
Wave 1 stays unauthorized and no artifact work begins.
The snapshot goes stale if its declared inputs change, which the generated check detects.
options.smallest_next_action: Do nothing. Re-run the generated-artifact check before reading the snapshot later.
